description: This file implements a cascade delete function for a chapter in a learning or content management system. It deletes associated data such as PDFs, questions, attempts, images, RAG conversations, embeddings, and the chapter entry itself, handling storage and vector store updates.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class managing vector embeddings stored locally, including loading, saving, and metadata management.

methods.name: cascade_delete_chapter
methods.description: Deletes a chapter and all related data, including files, questions, attempts, images, RAG conversations, embeddings, and the chapter record itself, updating storage and vector store accordingly.
